leads.jd:
Job Description: Manager-CEO's office 
 Role Overview: We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic thinker to join our team as a Strategy Associate/Manager. This role is pivotal in driving key initiatives and strategy projects that will shape the future of our organization. You will work closely with the CEO and leadership team to ensure rigor in problem-solving, strategic planning, and execution across various functions. This is meant to be a pre-MBA role, if you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about driving impactful change, this role is for you. Past Alumni have gotten admits at HBS, Wharton etc, Moved on to leadership roles at large MNCs.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Drive Strategic Projects: Lead critical strategy projects from 0->1 and 1->10, initiating and scaling new business initiatives across the organization.
 Org-level streamlining: Ensure timely interventions and rigorous problem-solving on key projects through close collaboration with leadership.
 Business Understanding & Metrics: Develop a deep understanding of the business and success metrics, tracking progress through detailed dashboards and analytics.
 Planning & Execution: Drive quarterly and annual planning cycles across the organization, and monitor execution through regular weekly reviews.
 Culture & Change Initiatives: Collaborate with functional and organizational leadership to drive initiatives that define and evolve the company culture.
 Qualification 
 Educational Background: Strong academic pedigree with an undergraduate degree from IITs/BITS 
 Experience: 
 2-4 years of experience in strategy consulting firms (MBB, ATK, Strategy&, Dalberg, Auctus), high-growth startups (Flipkart, Ola, Swiggy), or leading corporations (ITC, HUL, P&G).
 Demonstrable spike in academic or professional achievements.
 Skills & Attributes: 
 High degree of ownership and accountability.
 Strong aptitude and ability to quickly grasp new concepts and domains.
 Proven experience in structured problem-solving and stakeholder management.
 Ability to switch contexts and manage multiple priorities with passion, hunger, and perseverance.
 Desired Personal Traits: 
 Passionate about driving change and making an impact.
 Hunger for learning and growth, with the ability to persevere through challenges.
 Strong context-switching skills, comfortable navigating complex and dynamic environments.
 Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders.
 What We Offer: 
 Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership and have a meaningful impact on the organization’s strategic direction.
 A dynamic and entrepreneurial work environment where your ideas and contributions will be highly valued.
 Competitive compensation and benefits package.
 If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for solving complex problems and driving impactful change, we would love to hear from you!

leads.company_note: YC Winter 2026 · team of 8 · AI video editor (raw footage into finished videos)
leads.title: Founder's Office (speculative note to founders)
leads.jd:
Cardboard (cardboard.ai) is an AI video editor that turns raw footage into finished videos, from social clips and highlight reels to product demos, launch videos and event recaps. Describe the video you want, and Cardboard turns your clips, photos, recordings or a link into an edit you can watch, change and export, in the browser, in the Mac app, or right inside ChatGPT and Claude. It pulls out the best moments, removes pauses and filler words, adds captions, titles, music and B-roll, and reframes for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. It’s built for marketing teams, founders and creators who need video every week without learning a timeline.

Say what you need, like “three 30-second ad variants” or “a customer testimonial from these interviews”, and Cardboard’s AI agent, Director, builds a first cut in minutes. You refine it by chatting or on a full timeline, with your team. Cardboard edits the footage you already have. Unlike AI video generators such as Runway or Sora, it doesn’t create new video from a text prompt.

- Recreate the style of a reference video with your own footage.
- Make motion graphics from a prompt, from animated titles to 3D scenes like a spinning product shot.
- Cut to the beat, with match cuts, transitions and effects synced to the music.
- 80+ ready-made recipes (templates) for videos like launch videos, product showcases, podcast clips, webinar highlights, and testimonials.
- Export the finished video, or hand the timeline off to Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

Why now: AI models can finally understand video, and WebGPU makes a professional editor possible in a browser tab. Most AI video tools are either an old editor with AI bolted on, or an agent with no real editor behind it. Cardboard is built to be both.

Team: Saksham Aggarwal (CEO) and Ishan Sharma (CTO) have been friends for 15 years, since school. Saksham studied computer science at BITS Pilani, was co-founder and CTO of Iterate AI (backed by Entrepreneur First), and worked in growth at Sequoia-backed Flint. Ishan spent nearly five years building performance-critical browser apps at HackerRank (YC S11), and at 14 built Hotspoter, a Windows app with over 5 million downloads.

Together, they are unusually suited to build the editor core others avoid.

Video is becoming the default distribution channel, and the team that iterates fastest compounds attention. Cardboard becomes the default workspace for video production, the way Canva/Figma became the workspace for design - because it’s collaborative, fast, and does the tedious parts for you.

(formerly usecardboard.com or cardboard.sh)

leads.company_note: YC Summer 2020 · team of 25 · Ecosystem Platform for Restaurants in India
leads.title: Data Analyst
leads.jd:
Explorex — The Memory Layer for Physical Commerce

~90% of Indian retail happens in person, yet offline venues have no memory of their customers. Restaurants run on disconnected tools, and every visit ends with zero data captured. Explorex fixes this by owning both sides of the dining transaction.

At the center is Elite, our consumer app that is redefining how people dine out. Diners see live table availability, browse dynamic menus, order, and self-checkout instantly — no waiting, no interruptions. Behind it sits our infrastructure stack: Bridge OS (the full-stack restaurant operating system), Clyro (WhatsApp-native CRM), and ReserveX — all feeding a single behavioral data layer.

That data layer is what makes Explorex fundamentally different. Delivery platforms only see orders. We capture real-world, in-venue behavior — what people order, how long they stay, how groups behave, how menus perform, how experiences shape spending. Because we operate the restaurant OS and the consumer touchpoint, this data is irreplicable.

We're now building Elara, an AI dining concierge that turns this data into real-time decision-making — factoring intent, context, availability, and historical behavior. This moves us beyond discovery into becoming the intelligence layer for offline commerce.

Today, Explorex powers 250+ partner restaurants and 3M+ diners across Bangalore and Hyderabad, processing 8M+ transactions annually (18M+ lifetime), and operates at breakeven.

Explorex is not a SaaS tool — it is the infrastructure layer for offline dining, with AI and consumer experience at its core. Think Shopify for restaurants, on its way to becoming the UPI of restaurant operations.

leads.title: Product Analyst
leads.jd:
👩‍💻 THE ROLE

We're looking for a sharp, hungry analyst to join the data team at Headout. This is a foundational role, you'll work closely with senior analysts and leadership to build the reports, dashboards, and automations that power decisions across the company.

Depending on where the need is greatest and where your strengths lie, you could find yourself working on growth and marketing analytics, product analytics, operations and supply-side problems, or a mix of all three. The common thread: you'll be embedded in the business, working on problems that matter.

This isn't about crunching numbers in a corner. You'll understand how our marketplace works, why metrics move, and what levers actually drive outcomes. You'll ship real work within your first week, and own meaningful workstreams within your first few months.

If you're someone who gets restless when you're not learning, who'd rather figure things out than wait for instructions, and who cares about craft, this is for you.


🤩 WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE SPECIAL?

 - Real problems, not busywork: Headout is a global marketplace operating across dozens of cities, thousands of experiences, multiple currencies, real-time inventory, and dynamic pricing. Whether you're analyzing conversion funnels, attribution models, supplier economics, or product experiments, the problems here are genuinely hard.

 - Breadth of exposure: You won't be siloed into one corner of the business. You'll see how growth, product, operations, and finance interconnect and build the analytical muscle to work across all of them.

 - Learn fast by doing: You'll pair with senior analysts on complex projects, get direct feedback from leadership, and see your work influence actual decisions. The feedback loops are tight, and the growth curve is steep.

 - A team that gives a damn: We care about speed and pragmatism over perfection, but we don't ship sloppy work. Feedback is direct and frequent. We document what we learn. We help each other get better.

 - A product you can care about: Headout helps people experience the best of every city they visit. There's something satisfying about working on a product where the output is someone having a great day somewhere new.


💝 WHAT SKILLS & EXPERIENCE DO YOU NEED?

 - 1 - 3 years in an analytics, BI, or data science role

 - Strong SQL skills, you can write complex joins, window functions, CTEs without hand-holding. You know how to debug a slow query.

 - Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation, automation, or simple analysis

 - Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI)

 - Nice to have: exposure to dbt, Airflow, or similar; basic understanding of data warehousing concepts

 - Bonus: exposure to marketplace/e-commerce, consumer tech

leads.company: WedMeGood: India's Favourite Wedding Planning Platform
leads.title: Generalist – Strategy & Problem Solving
leads.jd:
About Us
 WedMeGood is India's leading wedding discovery platform, helping millions of couples discover and connect with wedding businesses across the country.
You can find the best wedding vendors, with prices and reviews at the click of a button. Whether you are looking to hire wedding planners in India, or looking for the top photographers, or just some ideas and inspiration for your wedding. WedMeGood can help you solve your wedding planning woes through its unique features. With a checklist, detailed vendor list, inspiration gallery and blog - you won't need to spend hours planning a wedding anymore.
 The Opportunity
 We’re looking for a sharp, curious generalist who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and coming up with unconventional, practical ideas.
This role is for someone who is comfortable jumping across different problem statements — from strategy and growth to customer experience, operations, new initiatives and everything in between. You should be able to quickly understand a problem, break it down, ask the right questions and find creative ways to solve it.
 What You’ll Do
 Work on high-impact, often loosely defined business problems. 
 Identify opportunities, bottlenecks and areas where things can be done differently. 
 Come up with creative, out-of-the-box solutions rather than defaulting to conventional playbooks. 
 Take ideas from a rough hypothesis to a structured plan and, where needed, execution. 
 Conduct research, talk to customers/partners, analyse data and connect seemingly unrelated dots. 
 Work closely with different teams and stakeholders to move projects forward. 
 Experiment quickly, learn from what works and what doesn’t, and iterate.
 Who We’re Looking For Someone Who
 Is naturally curious and enjoys figuring things out. 
 Has strong problem-solving and structured-thinking skills. 
 Can operate comfortably with ambiguity and limited direction. 
 Has a bias for action and doesn’t stop at making recommendations. 
 Thinks independently and is willing to challenge obvious answers. 
 Can move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution. 
 Communicates clearly and can simplify complex problems. 
 Is resourceful — when the answer isn’t obvious, you know how to find it.
 We care less about a specific background and more about how you think.
You could come from consulting, startups, product, growth, operations, strategy — or something completely different. What matters is intellectual curiosity, strong judgment and the ability to get things done.
This is NOT a wedding planner role, but we do love people who love weddings and everything around it.
 WHY JOIN US
 Opportunity to build a new business from the ground up.
 Direct exposure to founders and senior leadership.
 Significant ownership and autonomy.
 Chance to work at the intersection of SaaS, AI and hospitality.
 Learn how a category-leading internet company launches and scales new products.

leads.jd:
Badili is hiring for its Founders Office. The position is full time and is based at our Delhi offices in India.
 This role will work directly with the CEO across many functions of the business - operations, finance, partnerships, market expansion, retail, and brand. Seven markets, two operational hubs (Dubai and Hong Kong), partners like Amazon, Walmart, Carrefour and many others.
 This is not a support role. You will own workstreams end to end.
 What the job looks like:
 → Track monthly actuals against plan across all markets, flag what moved, recommend actions
 → Coordinate with distribution partners — telcos, retailers, e-commerce platforms
 → Support new-market entry — research, partner outreach, pricing, regulatory
 → Prepare board materials, partner briefs, decks, one-pagers
 → Own cross-functional projects from scoping to delivery — warehouse SOP rollouts, packaging redesigns, retail expansion playbooks, brand launches
 → Follow up on everything. Nothing drops.
 Who you are:
 → 8+ years of experience. 1–3 years in consulting, banking, VC, or startup ops
 → Sharp with numbers — P&Ls, pricing models, unit economics
 → Strong writer — board updates, partner briefs, internal memos, clear on the first pass
 → Comfortable across time zones and cultures — India, Dubai, Hong Kong, East and West Africa
 → Resourceful, low-ego, bias for action
 What you get:
 → Direct, daily access to the CEO — you see every decision and the reasoning behind it
 → Real ownership of real problems, not busywork
 → Exposure to global ops across Africa, Middle East, and Western markets
 → A fast track to a leadership role as we scale
 Based in India (Delhi NCR). Apply below or send your resume to Kalpita@badili.africa

 You will own the path from install to paid subscriber on one or more of our apps: onboarding, paywall, trial, autopay and retention. You work directly with the founders, engineers, designers and the ads team, and you get real ownership from week one — this is a backfill role, so you'll be stepping into live funnels and running experiments from day one, not easing in slowly.

 • Tear down competitor apps and bring back what is worth testing.
 • Work with the ads team so the promise in the ad matches the first screen of the app.

 • Use AI tools every day to move faster on research, specs, copy and analysis.
 Who we're looking for 
 You should have 
 • A feel for consumer apps in India, especially subscription, UPI autopay or content apps for the next billion users.
 • Comfort with numbers. You can read a funnel, question it, and explain what it means in two lines.
 • Clear writing in English and good spoken Hindi. You should be able to think like a user in Patna as easily as one in Pune.
 • A bias to ship. You would rather run a rough test this week than a perfect one next month.
 • Curiosity. You install apps just to see how their paywall works.

 • Hands-on experience with UPI AutoPay, mandate flows, recurring billing, or payment retry/dunning logic — big plus given our autopay and D2C payments work.
 • Exposure to paywalls, pricing tests, payment gateways (Razorpay, Juspay, etc.) or Meta ads.

leads.title: Associate - Strategy & Operations
leads.jd:
About BharatNXT 
 BharatNXT is a business payments platform on a mission to transform how Indian MSMEs manage their working capital. By enabling credit cards for business payments, we unlock liquidity and growth potential for entrepreneurs across the country. With a growing user base and robust product roadmap, we’re now setting our sights on building a high-conversion, high-traffic website from scratch. 
 The role 
 A generalist role working directly with the founders on whatever matters most: a launch, a partner going live, a pricing call, a broken workflow. You'll own each from first analysis to shipped outcome and be judged on what moved, not on the deck. Expect to switch problems often. 
 What you'll do 
 Own founder priorities - take the initiatives the founders are driving from rough idea to launch. Research the problem, write the brief, set milestones, get product, tech, ops and growth moving, and follow through until it ships. 
 Launch things - plan and run go-to-market for new products, features and partners, from positioning and pricing to phased rollout. Get the field and telecalling teams ready, and close each launch with a review of what worked. 
 Build partnerships - help find, evaluate and pitch new lending and payment partners. Once they're signed, keep integrations and timelines on track. 
 Turn numbers into decisions - own the dashboards and weekly reviews the business runs on: transactions, payment volume, activation, retention and unit economics. Find what's moving the numbers and turn it into a clear recommendation. 
 Know the market - track competitors, MSME behaviour, and RBI and card-network rules. Turn it into a monthly brief that changes what teams do, and flag anything that needs a decision now. 
 Run experiments - design small product and growth tests on pricing, offers and onboarding. Size each one, read the results with the growth team, and recommend what to scale or kill. 
 Strengthen operations - build and fix the processes behind the company: vendor and partner agreements, renewals, finance and compliance follow-ups, and hiring support. 
 Make us faster - find manual, repetitive work across ops, support and reporting. Replace it with better process, automation or AI tools, and measure the time and cost saved. 
 Take on special projects - anything important, urgent and without an owner yet. 
 What we're looking for 
 2 - 4 years at a startup, ideally working directly with founders and across several functions. 
 Structured thinking and clear writing - you can turn a messy problem into a plan, and a plan into a one-pager founders can decide on. 
 Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and you follow through without being chased. 
 Bonus: an MBA, IIT, IIM or CA and a business background. If you grew up around a family business or have run your own, MSME working-capital problems won't be abstract to you.

leads.title: Founders Office - Business
leads.jd:
Founder’s Office
 About Talkinglands
 Talkinglands is on a path to revolutionise how land and real estate are discovered, understood and sold. Using maps, data and visual storytelling, we are making every land parcel easy to see, trust and transact, for developers, landowners and buyers alike. The Founder’s Office is where that ambition turns into action.
 About The Role
 This is a business role, not a tech or product role. You will work completely on the business side of Talkinglands, with customers, partners and the market.
This is a fast-paced, aggressive, forward-looking role at an early-stage startup. You will work directly with the founders to win and grow customers, build our brand and presence, and understand the land and real estate market inside out. You will work closely with customers every day, while also contributing to marketing and market research. Your scope will grow as fast as you do.
 Read this before you apply. This role is not for everyone, and we want to be upfront about it:
 No task is too small or too big. One day you’ll be in a meeting with a large developer, the next you’ll be fixing a spreadsheet, making a reel or visiting a site
 This is not a 9-to-5. We need someone who doesn’t watch the clock and does what it takes to get things done
 You may be asked to work on weekends when the business needs it
 Your role will change as the company grows. You may be moved across customer success, marketing, research, sales or any other area where you’re needed most
 If you have the hunger to learn, grow fast and build something big, this is the place for you. If you’re looking for a fixed role, fixed hours and a comfortable routine, please don’t apply.
What you’ll do
 Onboard customers and be their main point of contact, making sure they get value from Talkinglands quickly
 Build strong relationships with developers, landowners, brokers and partners through calls, meetings and site visits
 Understand customer needs deeply and help them use Talkinglands to solve real problems
 Turn customer wins into referrals, testimonials and case studies
 Spot upsell and renewal opportunities and help close them
 Bring customer feedback back to the team to make Talkinglands better
 Build the Talkinglands brand through content, events and partnerships with developers, brokers and industry bodies
 Research land and real estate markets, including prices, growth corridors, infrastructure projects and key players, and turn it into insights for customers, content and the platform
 Pick up whatever the business needs most at any given time, big or small, and drive it to completion
 Prepare decks, reports and updates for internal and external meetings
 Who you are
We care more about your hunger and what you’ve built than where you studied. Enthusiasm to learn, the drive to execute and real-world results matter to us more than anything else on your CV.
 You have started something of your own, whether a startup, a YouTube channel, a page, a side project…
